newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Dec 18.

text.p: The House of Commons will begin its Christmas recess after a fairly routine day of business on Wednesday.

Of greater interest will be an event away from parliament -- a speech Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke is to give at 1330 gmt to the Royal Institute of International Affairs on Britain and the European Union.
- Adjournment debates, including at 1230 gmt one on Nigeria and the Commonwealth Ministers' Action Group.
- Questions to the Scottish Secretary at 1430 gmt.
- Public Service Committee questions Sir Robin Butler, head of the home civil service and secretary of the cabinet on his role and responsibilities. 1545 GMT
- Environment Committee publishes report on Contaminated Land. 1000 GMT
- Conclusion of proceedings on the Protection from Harassment Bill.
- Second reading of the National Heritage Bill (Lords). -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
